# Net-sales brief
Month: 2026-09. Audience: finance lead. Include only rows whose status is paid and month is 2026-09. Sum their amount_usd and refund_usd separately; net is gross minus refunds. Exclude cancelled rows and all other months. Do not round or invent data. Required inputs are orders_csv and reporting_month. Local outputs only. A verification pass must inspect the included row IDs and sums.
